originality.rationale: The inspected primary 2026 affine-transitive synthesis theorem does not determine this multiorbit cross. The inspected earlier finite-group spectral-synthesis paper supplies general estimates; indexed sharp fourth-moment coordinate-cross results use the distinct ell2-to-L4 extension objective. Earlier equal-field fourth-power synthesis formulas are acknowledged strict special cases. Neither the full real-exponent unequal-factor constant nor the dimension-dependent critical-exponent sign transition was found in the actual targeted searches. A possible older equivalent additive-product point-evaluation formula remains a residual bibliographic risk.
residual_risks: An older product-space Banach-space point-evaluation norm or additive-array minimization theorem could be equivalent without using Fourier-synthesis terminology.
The arXiv v2 paper contains more than its exact-constant theorem, but its inspected most relevant main result assumes transitivity; no blanket noncoverage is asserted for all possible references.
Prior published r=4 equal-field synthesis values are covered special cases and cannot separately establish novelty.

The exact continuum-exponent norm, complete equality family and unique critical-exponent change in the optimal center coefficient characterize a natural nontrivial family; the sign transition is invisible from one fourth-power case.
